gaps.sentence: Don't ___ your children — let them make their own mistakes (PROTECT).
gaps.hint: protect too much (over-); a base verb is needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix over- means excessively: overprotect means to protect too much. A base verb follows 'Don't'.

gaps.sentence: She was praised for her ___ (TOLERATE) of other viewpoints.
The ___ (IDENTIFY) of the body took weeks.
gaps.hint: noun: the act of establishing who
gaps.explanation: 'The identification of the body' — the process noun is required.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (CONFIDENT) was shaken by the failure.
It was ___ of you to double-check the figures (SENSE).
gaps.explanation: 'It was sensible of you to do something' praises good judgement; 'sensitive' means easily affected.

gaps.sentence: The new bypass will be ___ (BENEFIT) to thousands of commuters.
gaps.explanation: 'Be beneficial to' — the adjective follows the verb 'be'.

gaps.sentence: She was fired for ___ behaviour at work (PROFESSIONAL).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed before the noun 'behaviour'
gaps.explanation: The prefix un- forms the negative adjective: unprofessional behaviour is behaviour below professional standards.
The noun of 'wise' is 'wisdom' (-dom suffix); 'wisedom' is a common misspelling.
